segments.text: In one survey, only 53% of households stored three days of water.
Many of us mean to build an emergency kit. Then the list feels too big, so we never start.
A 2014 survey of 572 adults found 96% had three days of food, but only 53% had three days of water.
Try one item per payday. One: start with water, about a gallon per person per day. Two: add one shelf-stable food to your next shopping list. Three: keep it all in one labeled bin.
This was one self-reported survey, and needs vary by household. Follow your local guidance.
Try it today: add one gallon of water to your shopping list.
